script.text: Shark, I'm so sorry... about everything.
Yeah, right! After everything you pulled?
You have to believe me. It was all because of Vetrix!
I never should have followed his orders, but I did.
When I dueled your sister, Vetrix forced me to use a powerful card.
It was because of that card that she wound up hurt.
I felt terribly about what had happened.
I never meant to hurt her, but that's what Vetrix planned.
As his son, I didn't think and just did what my father asked.
Please, Shark. Bring my real father back!
